mapper.select: select count(*) from app_member where status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(*) from app_member where status = 'INACTIVE'
mapper.update: update app_member set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select:
select m.member_id as memberId , m.user_id as userId , m.member_name as memberName , m.nickname as nickname , m.phone as phone , m.email as email , m.user_type as userType , m.login_type as loginType , m.status as status , m.last_login_at as lastLoginAt , m.created_at as createdAt , m.updated_at as updatedAt
, ( select count(*) from vehicle v where v.member_id = m.member_id and v.is_deleted = false ) as vehicleCount
, ( select count(*) from reservation r where r.member_id = m.member_id ) as reservationCount
, ( select count(*) from charging_session cs where cs.member_id = m.member_id and cs.status = '완료' ) as completedSessionCount
, ( select coalesce(sum(cs.actual_cost), 0) from charging_session cs where cs.member_id = m.member_id and cs.status = '완료' ) as totalPaymentAmount
from app_member m where m.member_id = #{memberId}

select v.vehicle_id as vehicleId , v.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , v.plate_number as plateNumber , v.is_default as isDefault , v.created_at as createdAt , vm.manufacturer as manufacturer , vm.model_name as modelName from vehicle v join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id where v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.is_deleted = false order by v.is_default desc, v.created_at desc

select r.reservation_id as reservationId , cs.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , v.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , vm.model_name as modelName , r.start_time as startTime , r.end_time as endTime , r.status as status , r.estimated_cost as estimatedCost from reservation r join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id where r.member_id = #{memberId} order by r.created_at desc

select cs.session_id as sessionId , cs.reservation_id as reservationId , st.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , v.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , vm.model_name as modelName , cs.actual_start_time as actualStartTime , cs.actual_end_time as actualEndTime , cs.actual_kwh as actualKwh , cs.actual_cost as actualCost , cs.status as status from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id join vehicle v on cs.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id where cs.member_id = #{memberId} order by cs.actual_start_time desc

select cs.session_id as sessionId , cs.reservation_id as reservationId , st.station_name as stationName , cs.actual_kwh as actualKwh , cs.actual_cost as actualCost , cs.actual_end_time as paidAt , cs.status as status from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where cs.member_id = #{memberId} and cs.status = '완료' order by cs.actual_end_time desc
